run_metadata.coverage_summary: All source tiers were attempted (Tier 1 Commonwealth + all states/territories; Tier 2 councils/GBEs/universities/health; Tier 3 private-sector e-sourcing hubs and major-buyer portals; plus a dedicated source-discovery sweep). Connectivity was re-tested at the start of the run: WebFetch returned EGRESS_BLOCKED for the Tier 1 control fetch to www.tenders.gov.au, and a direct curl to www.tenders.gov.au and www.tenders.nsw.gov.au returned '403 CONNECT tunnel failed'. The agent-proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true, selective=false, bundleCoversEveryHost=true, recentRelayFailures empty, yet every external CONNECT is rejected (only infrastructure hosts in noProxy - Anthropic API, npm/PyPI/crates/go package registries - are reachable). This is the SAME session-wide deny-by-default egress block seen on the 2026-09-30, 2026-10-01, 2026-10-02, 2026-10-03, 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-05 runs - now SEVEN consecutive days. Per the proxy README this is an organisation policy denial (403/407) that must be reported, not routed around. WebSearch still works (it routes through the Anthropic API, not the egress proxy) and was used for a source-discovery sweep across Tiers 1-3. Because the spec's fidelity rule requires every tender detail to be taken from the actual notice or its documents, and no notice or tender-detail page could be opened or verified, NO opportunity could be confirmed - so this run records ZERO tenders rather than repeating unverified aggregator/search snippets. The source-discovery sweep surfaced five buyer-originated procurement sources not present in any prior run (Stanwell Corporation; Icon Water; V/Line Corporation; CS Energy; Boeing Defence Australia); all are recorded in discovered_sources with a clear note that they were surfaced via WebSearch and could NOT be fetch-verified this run due to the egress block. No tenders, deliverables, dates, contacts, or corporate opportunities were invented.
gaps: Session-wide organisation egress block (7th consecutive day): WebFetch returns EGRESS_BLOCKED and direct curl returns '403 CONNECT tunnel failed' for external hosts (control fetches to www.tenders.gov.au and www.tenders.nsw.gov.au both rejected). No external website could be opened or verified this run.

Tier 1 (AusTender, NSW eTendering/buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, ACT Tenders): attempted but UNREACHABLE - every notice/detail page blocked by egress policy; zero tenders could be verified.
Tier 2 (councils via VendorPanel, GBEs/government-owned corporations, universities/TAFEs, public health): attempted via WebSearch only; no detail page could be fetched to verify an opportunity.

Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, Coupa/Jaggaer/GEP/Ivalua, RangeMe, and major-buyer portals BHP/Rio Tinto/Woodside/Woolworths/Coles etc.): attempted via WebSearch only; all portals remain unreachable for fetch. No corporate opportunity could be verified; none invented. Login/registration-gated and invitation-only corporate RFx remain out of scope per spec.

Opportunities surfaced only as WebSearch signals and NOT recorded as tenders (could not be fetch-verified, so treated as discovery signal only, not source-of-truth): a Department of Finance 'Provision for Drupal and Digital Experience Platform Services' (GovCMS) notice reportedly closing ~7 Oct 2026; an AIFFP (Australian Infrastructure Financing Facility for the Pacific) Support Facility EOI reportedly closing ~16 Oct 2026. Each needs a detail-page fetch to confirm IDs, scope, deliverables, dates and contacts before it could be recorded as a tender; neither was recorded.
Detail/deliverables extraction: not possible for any opportunity this run because no notice or tender document could be opened.

Discovered sources this run could not be fetch-verified (URL resolution, feed/API presence, and current-opportunity confirmation all pending) due to the egress block; each is noted accordingly and should be re-checked once egress is restored.

Proxy status checked (curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status): enabled=true, selective=false, bundleCoversEveryHost=true, recentRelayFailures empty, but no external tender domain is permitted - consistent with an allowlist that admits only infrastructure hosts (Anthropic API, package registries). This is an environment/configuration issue, not a transient network error, and has now persisted for seven days.
recommended_seed_additions: Stanwell Corporation - Doing business with us (https://www.stanwell.com/doing-business-with-us) - Queensland Government-Owned Corporation (electricity generation/energy). Runs the Zycus Supplier Network (ZSN) for its RFx and advertises open-market tenders on the Queensland Government Supplier Portal / QTenders (supply.qld.gov.au). Buyer-originated QLD energy GBE not previously tracked.

Icon Water - Supplying goods or services to Icon Water (https://www.iconwater.com.au/About-Us/Supplying-goods-or-services-to-Icon-Water) - ACT water/sewerage GBE (jointly owned by the ACT Government). Publishes current tenders via TenderLink (https://portal.tenderlink.com/iconwater). Buyer-originated ACT water GBE; ACT GBE water coverage was absent.

V/Line Corporation - Procurement / Tenders (https://corporate.vline.com.au/Procurement/Tenders) - Victorian regional rail GBE. Uses the Zycus Supplier Network for tender events and also lists opportunities on Buying for Victoria (tenders.vic.gov.au). Buyer-originated VIC rail GBE not previously tracked.

CS Energy - Suppliers (https://www.csenergy.com.au/suppliers) - Queensland Government-Owned Corporation (electricity generation). Advertises public tenders via VendorPanel Marketplace and the Queensland Government Supplier Portal (supply.qld.gov.au). Buyer-originated QLD energy GBE; complements Stanwell and Energy Queensland already noted.

Boeing Defence Australia - Becoming a Supplier (https://www.boeingsuppliers.com/become) - defence prime (subsidiary of Boeing). Supplier registration via the Enterprise Supplier LifeCycle (ESLC) portal and Exostar/Boeing Supplier Portal (boeingsuppliers.com/portal); ~AUD 400M annual spend across 2,300+ Australian suppliers. Registration-gated corporate buyer source for defence subcontract opportunities; diversifies defence-prime coverage.

ENVIRONMENT FIX (highest priority): the daily routine cannot fulfil its core mission while the egress proxy blocks all external hosts (now seven days). Allowlist the Tier 1 government tender domains (tenders.gov.au, tenders.nsw.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au/buyingfor.vic.gov.au, qtenders.hpw.qld.gov.au/supply.qld.gov.au, tenders.wa.gov.au, tenders.sa.gov.au, tenders.tas.gov.au, tendersonline.nt.gov.au, tenders.act.gov.au), plus vendorpanel.com.au, portal.tenderlink.com and service.ariba.com, so WebFetch can open and verify notices.
